description: Use this when a visitor asks how crowded one supported park actually was on recent days, or how accurate Parky's forecast has been.

days.description: Park-local days back including today, 1 to 60. Defaults to 14.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.

name: parky_get_crowd_actuals
title: Get observed crowds
